title: Rename verbs / action_verbs / VerbSpec to actions across engine, frontend, tests, and tooling

sections.what: Rename `verb` / `verbs` / `action_verbs` / `VerbSpec` / `ActionVerbs` terminology and modules to `action` / `actions` / `ActionSpec` / `Actions` across Python (`engine/`, `routes/`, `tools/`, `tests/`), TypeScript/JavaScript (`static/js/`), templates (`templates/index.html`), and docs.
sections.why: Every other subsystem in VirtualWorld refers to what a character does as an `action` (`action_handlers.py`, `apply_action`, `AVAILABLE ACTIONS`, `ActionInterpreter`, `TurnQueue` action slots), while the registry alone calls them `verbs` (`engine/action_verbs.py`, `VerbSpec`, `action-verbs.generated.js`, `window.ActionVerbs`, `tools/action_verbs_index.py`). Standardizing on `actions` removes the split vocabulary.
sections.how:
1. Rename `engine/action_verbs.py` -> `engine/actions.py` (with `ActionSpec`, `ACTION_SPECS`, `all_actions`, etc., plus thin re-export shim in `engine/action_verbs.py` only if needed during transition).
2. Update `tools/action_verbs_index.py` (or rename to `tools/actions_index.py`) and generated bundle `static/js/agent/actions.generated.js` (`window.Actions`, keeping `window.ActionVerbs = window.Actions` alias if any external script references it) + update `<script>` tag in `templates/index.html`.
3. Update all callers in `routes/action_handlers.py`, `engine/`, `static/js/agent/`, `tests/test_action_verbs.py` -> `tests/test_actions.py`, and `tools/unit/`.
4. Run `npm run build:ts`, JS unit tests, and `pytest` to verify zero broken imports or globals.
sections.verify: Run `npm run build:ts`, `pytest tests/test_actions.py`, and `node tools/unit/run.cjs` across action/plan/prompt suites.

acceptance.text: Canonical registry and spec types use Action / Actions (`ActionSpec`, `ACTION_SPECS`, `window.Actions`) across Python and TypeScript.
Generator script, index check, `templates/index.html`, and all engine/frontend callers are updated and compile cleanly (`npm run build:ts` exit 0).
All Python and JS unit tests for action registration, cost tiers, and prompt/plan grounding pass.
